title: Property Occupancy and the Rate Lock Commitment Extension Rate
content:
How the borrower will occupy the property, as recorded on the **Mortgage Loan File**, adds a step to the per-day cost of a **Rate Lock Commitment** extension, in basis points. The adjusted per-day cost is never taken below zero.

**Rule.** An investment property adds the investment step of **0.5** basis points. A second home adds the second-home step of **0.25** basis points. A primary residence adds none.

| Occupancy on the loan file | Step (basis points) |
|---|---|
| Investment property | 0.5 |
| Second home | 0.25 |
| Primary residence | 0 |

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a product whose extension cost is 2.5 basis points per day, a second-home file with no other change prices the extension at 2.75 basis points per day.
